versions.name: Bear Paw Scout Camp
versions.address: 14000 Bear Paw Camp Ln Mountain, Wisconsin 54149-0128

features.note: A lakeside fire circle for council fires and ceremonies.
A spacious chapel on a wooded point overlooking the water.
A large modern dining hall for communal meals.
Includes ice fishing in the winter season.
Part of the winter season program.
Marked cycling trails of up to fifty miles around camp.
Units can eat in the dining hall or cook patrol meals in their own sites.
A well-stocked trading post for snacks and memorabilia.
On the shores of Bear Paw Lake in the Nicolet National Forest.

provenance.notes: Name corrected 2026-07-22 (community/data-quality review): 'Scouts BSA Summer Camp - Bear Paw Scout Camp' was a scraped registration-event title; renamed to the property name, verified against the council's camp listing. Prior id 'wi-scouts-bsa-summer-camp-bear-paw-scout-camp' retired (resolves via aliases.json). Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/635-2026summercampbearpaw); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
